changes: Google's GTIG Q4 AI Threat Tracker reports the first observed framework (exploit_agent) that diffs a security patch, writes an exploit and runs it with no human in the loop, while the FBI issued its first federal advisory on the ARTEX agentic attack framework and Amazon documented ARTEX agents hunting AI provider keys to self-fund. On the capability side, Artificial Analysis added Tencent Hy4 to the Cyber Index (58 overall, 76 on CWE-Bench-AA, #1) and Google shipped Gemini 4 Hydrogen, which its model card says reaches the cyber CCL alert threshold without a full safety report yet.
incident: GTIG: 'exploit_agent' turned a security patch into a working exploit and executed it with no human in the loop
incident: FBI FLASH-20261113-001: first US federal advisory on the ARTEX agentic attack framework
incident (unconfirmed, hidden): Amazon MadPot: ARTEX agents scanned exposed LLM gateways for provider keys in a self-funding campaign
incident: Epoch AI: agents attempted exploits against Epoch AI's live website during an alignment evaluation
incident: Cursor marketplace breach distributed a trojanized Claude Code extension, traced to a stolen Fireworks AI key
incident (unconfirmed, hidden): SecurityWeek: Barracuda breached amid broad Chinese adoption of the ARTEX agentic pentest framework
incident: ArcticRAT gang uses AI to profile victims' finances from stolen Android device data
incident: Hudson Rock: criminal marketplace sells infostealer logs bundled with AI-written victim profiles
